title: How Much Does Botox Cost in Florida? (2026 Price Guide)
h1: How much does Botox cost in Florida?
lede: Botox is priced per unit, so your total depends on how many units your treatment areas need. In Florida, per-unit pricing typically runs in the low-to-mid teens, with Miami-area medical spas often at the higher end. The only way to get your exact number is a consultation.
sections: How Botox pricing works

Clinics charge per unit. A frown-line treatment commonly uses about 20 units; forehead lines and crow's-feet add more, so two people can pay very different totals at the same per-unit price. Ask how many units a provider recommends and who performs the injection.
What changes your price

Injector experience, the number of areas treated, the product used (Botox, Dysport or Xeomin), and any current promotions. For a medical injectable, the cheapest quote is not automatically the best choice.
How to get an accurate quote
Most Florida providers quote at a free consultation. Compare verified providers near you using the links below.
faqs: Is Botox priced per unit or per area?
Almost always per unit. Compare the total units times the rate.
Why is Botox more expensive in Miami?
Higher-demand metro markets and experienced injectors often price at the higher end. Compare several verified providers rather than assuming.

title: Botox vs Dysport vs Xeomin: Differences, Cost and How to Choose
lede: Botox, Dysport and Xeomin are all botulinum-toxin type-A injectables that soften dynamic wrinkles. They all work; they differ in dosing, spread, and onset speed, not in whether they are effective.
sections: The key differences

Dysport units are not 1:1 with Botox units and it tends to spread a little more, useful for larger areas like the forehead. Xeomin is a purified formulation. Onset is roughly 2 to 4 days for Dysport and 3 to 7 days for Botox and Xeomin; all last about 3 to 4 months.
Cost comparison
Because unit counts differ between products, per-unit price is misleading. Always compare the total quoted for your treatment, not the sticker per-unit rate.
How to choose
Pick the injector first and the product second. An experienced provider recommends a product based on your treatment area and history.
faqs: Is Dysport cheaper than Botox?
Sometimes per unit, but Dysport typically uses more units, so compare total cost.
Which one lasts the longest?
All last roughly 3 to 4 months; duration depends more on dose and metabolism than brand.

title: How Much Does Lip Filler Cost in Florida? (2026 Price Guide)
h1: How much does lip filler cost in Florida?
lede: Lip filler is priced per syringe, so your total depends on how many syringes you need and which product your injector uses. In Florida, a single syringe of hyaluronic-acid lip filler commonly runs from the mid-hundreds to around a thousand dollars, with Miami-area medical spas often at the higher end. Your exact price comes from a consultation.
sections: How lip filler pricing works

Most lip fillers are hyaluronic-acid (HA) products such as Juvederm or Restylane, sold by the syringe (often 0.5 mL or 1 mL). A first-time treatment frequently uses half a syringe to one full syringe. Because pricing is per syringe, two people can pay very different totals depending on how much product they need.
What changes your price

Injector experience and credentials, the brand and amount of filler, your treatment goals, and any current promotions. Metro markets like Miami tend to price higher than smaller Florida towns. For a medical injectable, the lowest quote is not automatically the best choice — who injects you matters.
How to get an accurate quote

faqs: Is lip filler priced per syringe or per session?
Almost always per syringe. Ask how many syringes your provider recommends and multiply by the per-syringe rate.
How much is a full syringe of lip filler in Miami?
Miami-area pricing for one HA syringe commonly falls in the mid-hundreds to around a thousand dollars; compare several verified providers for an exact quote.

title: Lip Filler vs Botox: What's the Difference and Which Do You Need?
lede: Lip filler and Botox are different tools for different jobs. Lip filler adds volume and shape using hyaluronic acid; Botox is a muscle-relaxing injectable that softens wrinkles caused by movement. Many people confuse them, but they treat different concerns.
sections: What each one does

Lip filler (an HA product like Juvederm or Restylane) plumps and defines the lips by adding volume. Botox (a botulinum-toxin injectable) relaxes specific muscles to smooth dynamic lines such as frown lines and crow's-feet. A 'lip flip' is a small Botox technique that gently everts the upper lip — it is not the same as adding filler volume.
How long they last
HA lip filler typically lasts about 6 to 18 months. Botox usually lasts about 3 to 4 months. Because Botox wears off faster, it needs more frequent touch-ups.
Cost and choosing

Filler is priced per syringe; Botox is priced per unit — so the two are not directly comparable on price. Pick your goal first: more volume and shape means filler; softening movement wrinkles means Botox. An experienced injector can combine both when it makes sense.
faqs: Can you get lip filler and Botox at the same time?
Yes, providers often combine them, for example filler for lip volume plus a Botox lip flip. Discuss your goals at a consultation.
Which is cheaper, Botox or lip filler?
They are priced differently (units vs syringes) and treat different things, so compare total treatment cost, not sticker rates.

title: How Long Does Lip Filler Last? What to Expect
h1: How long does lip filler last?
lede: Most hyaluronic-acid lip fillers last about 6 to 18 months, with many people seeing results hold for roughly 9 to 12 months before a touch-up. How long yours lasts depends on the product, your metabolism, and how much was placed.
sections: Typical timeline

After the initial swelling settles (usually one to two weeks), your final result appears. HA lip filler then gradually breaks down over months. Smaller amounts and faster metabolisms tend to fade sooner; larger placements can last longer.
What affects how long it lasts

The filler brand and formulation, how much product was used, your metabolism and activity level, and how the area moves all influence longevity. Lips are highly mobile, so lip filler often fades a bit faster than filler in less-active areas.
Maintaining your results

Many people schedule a touch-up once or twice a year. HA fillers can also be dissolved with hyaluronidase if you want to reverse or adjust them. A qualified injector can recommend a maintenance schedule.
faqs: Does lip filler last longer the more you get it?
Some people find results hold a little longer with repeat treatments, but this varies. Longevity depends mostly on product, dose, and metabolism.
Can lip filler be dissolved early?
Yes. HA lip filler can be dissolved with an enzyme called hyaluronidase if you want to reverse it.

title: How Long Does Botox Last? What to Expect
lede: Botox typically lasts about 3 to 4 months. First-time patients sometimes notice it wears off a little sooner, and results can vary with the dose, the area treated, and your metabolism.
sections: Typical timeline

Botox usually starts working within 3 to 7 days and reaches full effect around two weeks. The muscle-relaxing result then gradually fades over roughly 3 to 4 months as the product wears off and movement returns.
What affects how long it lasts

The number of units used, the specific muscle treated, your metabolism, and how expressive the area is all matter. Under-dosing to save money often means results fade faster, so the cheapest treatment is not always the best value.
Keeping results consistent

Many people book touch-ups every 3 to 4 months to maintain a smooth look. Staying on a regular schedule can help results look consistent over time. Your injector can recommend a cadence based on how you respond.
faqs: Does Botox last longer over time?
Some regular patients find they need slightly less product or fewer sessions over time, but the typical duration stays around 3 to 4 months.
Why did my Botox wear off quickly?
Lower doses, a very active muscle, or a faster metabolism can shorten how long it lasts. Discuss dosing with your injector.

title: How Long Does Microneedling Last? Results and Timeline
lede: A single microneedling session gives a fresh, glowing look that often lasts several weeks, while the collagen-building benefits keep developing for months. Most providers recommend a series of sessions for longer-lasting results.
sections: What to expect after one session

In the days to weeks after microneedling, skin can look brighter and smoother as it heals. This initial glow commonly lasts around 4 to 6 weeks. Underneath, the treatment stimulates collagen, which keeps improving skin texture over the following months.
How long the results last

Because microneedling works by building collagen, results are cumulative. A course of about 3 to 6 sessions spaced a few weeks apart tends to produce the most noticeable, longer-lasting improvement — often holding for several months. Many people maintain results with a session every 6 to 12 months.
What affects longevity
Your skin concern, skincare routine, sun protection, and whether you complete a full series all affect how long results last. Consistent sun protection helps preserve the improvement.
faqs: Is one microneedling session enough?
One session gives a temporary glow, but most providers recommend a series of 3 to 6 for lasting collagen-building results.
How often should you get microneedling?
A common approach is an initial series a few weeks apart, then maintenance every 6 to 12 months depending on your goals.
